name: David Warmington
title: Psychologist
description: I began my counselling career in 2002, working in a drug and alcohol outreach team. From 2008 I have worked as a clinical psychologist, gaining experience in both inpatient and community mental health settings before beginning private practice.
specialties: Gender Dysphoria, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), EMDR, Schema Therapy

name: Walter Poon
title: Contact Psychologist
description: Services listed on APS profile: Gender Dysphoria, Sexual difficulties.

name: Lara Dolling
title: Psychologist
description: Lara Dolling is an Endorsed Clinical and Counselling Psychologist and Board Approved Supervisor with over a decade of experience supporting individuals and couples across a range of mental health and life challenges. She offers a warm, welcoming, and non-judgmental therapeutic space, working collaboratively with clients, guided by a strong belief that meaningful change is possible. Her approach is grounded in compassion, respect, and a trauma-informed, attachment-based framework.

name: Dr Vanessa Petersen
title: Contact Psychologist
description: Dr Vanessa Petersen is a Clinical Neuropsychologist and director of Neurotype, offering neurodiversity-affirming assessments for children and young people aged 6 to 25. Vanessa works with young people whose strengths and struggles don't fit neatly into one box.

name: Sylvia Niele
title: Psychologist
address: 758-760 High Street, Complete Health Care, Level 2
description: Sylvia Niele is a registered Clinical Psychologist and Medicare Provider and works with a diverse range of presentations including: depression, anxiety and phobias, abuse and trauma (especially PTSD), parenting/family challenges, loss/bereavement, autism spectrum disorders, adjustment issues, self-esteem, ageing, chronic pain management, obsessive compulsive disorders, compulsive eating, and personality related issues. Sylvia takes a collaborative, emotion-focused, and humanistic approach drawing on CBT (cognitive behaviour therapy), ACT (acceptance and commitment therapy), imaginal exposure, CPT (cognitive processing therapy) mindfulness, attachment theory, existential and interpersonal psychotherapy, DBT (dialectical behaviour therapy), Schema Therapy, narrative therapy, positive psychology, and in particular, Intensive Short Term Dynamic Psychotherapy (ISTDP).
specialties: Partners/families of sex offenders, Sexual abuse, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Gender Dysphoria, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)

name: Dr Alison Lubliner
title: Psychologist
description: Dr Alison Lubliner is a clinical psychologist with extensive experience supporting adolescents and adults. She has a warm and caring approach and is neuroaffirming.
specialties: Gender Dysphoria, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, EMDR, Schema Therapy

name: Sheryl Brosnan
title: Psychologist
description: I work with compassion and curiosity to support healing and learning so that we can become more fully who we are. Drawing on many years of attachment informed trauma work, process and emotion focussed practice, CBT, mindfulness practices and narrative and family therapy I support the surfacing and exploration of purpose, passion and core values and the understanding of the deep fears, limiting beliefs and blockages that get in the way.
specialties: Dissociative Identity Disorder, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse

name: Dr Ninawa Butrus
title: Psychologist
description: Dr Ninawa Butrus – Clinical and Forensic Psychologist. CLINICAL PSYCHOLOGY: Psychological assessment, diagnosis and therapy for adult clients (aged 18+ years): – Personality Disorders, particularly Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD) – Trauma, Complex Trauma & PTSD – Addictive, Impulsive or Compulsive Behaviours (e.g., pathological lying, skin-picking) – Substance Use Issues – Anxiety & Avoidance – Depression – Stress & Coping Issues – Dissociation & Depersonalisation – Emotional Dysregulation – Forensic Issues / Offending Behaviours.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, EMDR, Schema Therapy
